from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection: its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    citations: list[str] | None = Field(description="List of titles of papers referenced in this document's bibliography; the inference agent will filter these to the set of known paper titles")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
